current_activity: Battle of Toulon: the division liberates the city after heavy fighting

notes: Event date: 6 February 1945 (Wikipedia; CMH Riviera to the Rhine, p. 551). notes: Event date: 4 April 1945, between 06.00 and 10.30 (de Lattre, p. 436).
